entity.description: One dataset endpoint the index reads, and the record kind its records are (fixed, or by a field's value).

field.name: recordKind
field.description: The kind every record is (ORDER, RETURN ...); blank when recordKindField decides.

field.name: recordKindField
field.description: A field whose value names the kind (NetSuite type), mapped by recordKindMapJson.

field.name: recordKindMapJson
field.description: {"SalesOrd":"ORDER", ...}; an unmapped value skips the record.

field.name: idField
field.description: The record's own key (the dataset's idField).

field.name: kindHintEntity
field.description: Where a read's record kind is named when the records do not carry it: an entity whose primary key is the read's connection (NetSuite: darpan.reconciliation.NsSuiteQlSourceQuery).

field.name: kindHintField
field.description: That entity's field holding the value recordKindMapJson maps (recordType).

entity.description: One ID-like field of a source's records: the record's own identifier (OWN) or a pointer to another record (REF).

field.name: recordKind
field.description: Blank: every kind of the source.

field.name: refRecordKind
field.description: REF only: the kind it points at, when known.

entity.description: A tenant's own ID field, or its override of a product field with the same fieldId (isActive N hides it).

One ID of one record in one system: the normalised value, and the record it belongs to. Added or touched by every Darpan read that sees it, never deleted by a read (a run's extract may carry only some fields); the nightly sweep drops rows not seen for darpan.idindex.months.

field.name: rowKey
field.description: SHA-1 hex of tenant, connection, kind, record, field and value: one row per id, whoever writes it.

field.name: idNorm
field.description: IdNormalizer.normalize: trimmed, no leading #, Shopify gid reduced to its number, uppercase.

field.name: recordKey
field.description: The record's own key in its system (normalised).

entity.description: How far the index has read one dataset: the last read and the kept copy version indexed, the last error.

field.name: indexedVersion
field.description: The kept copy version last indexed in full; behind the dataset's currentVersion, the nightly catch-up indexes it again.
